script: I needed one cart, but the grumpy owner turned trip into chaos.. I was already late and needed a roll of tape, so I sprinted into the store, like a human blur. The sign outside screamed You need a shopping cart to enter! (I am already like, "I know, I know.") The owner, a grumpy old guy, blocks my way. I almost collide with him. "You can't shop here without a…" he starts. "Yeah, I only need—" I cut him off. "Nooooo, no cart, no shop!" he yells, sounding like he's lecturing a toddler who tried to paint the walls with diapers. I turn, grab TWO carts, push one, pull the other, and weave through the aisles. He gives me that smug grin. I text my wife that I'll be a minute. I stroll up and down every aisle, like I am doing a grocery marathon. At checkout, I line up two empty carts. I drop my scotch tape on the belt at the far end, upright, so it won't roll. I push both carts into the trolley lane—totally empty. The owner frowns, says nothing, but I can feel his anger. Back at the cashier, who's about to crack up, the owner's voice comes from the other side of the store. I mimic it: "No cart, no shop. Now two carts, one shop. Otay dada?" The bossman's ear is right next to the cashier's. The owner yells, I am banned. He throws me out, no tape, no chance. He sells the place to a nice family, but the sign still hangs, and no one gives a damn.
